header.sector: AI model developers and AI platforms / applications
header.title: China's unconstrained AI release and price war pressures Western frontier lab economics

s01_bottom_line.text: SemiAnalysis documents that 9 leading Chinese labs ship models at a rapidly rising cadence (857 releases, 101 in Q3 2025, >half open-weight) with almost no safety-gating, and reports Anthropic's economics being squeezed by cheap open-weight rivals especially in China.

A speed-first, open-weight Chinese release war that no safety regime slows could erode pricing power and terminal value for Western frontier model developers that attempt to pace themselves, though the article quantifies no earnings or revenue impact.

The dataset includes 857 counted model releases
Open-weight releases make up more than half of every quarter since mid-2023

China's frontier labs are in a release and price war
